scientific_decision: Typed values, exception propagation, argument-only repair, activation checks and whole-task accounting are not claimed as novel. P78 is an ordinary failure-presentation comparison; observed time feedback and pre-exception path differences limit causal interpretation. Preserve all eight cells and the original gate.
